identity.title: [v0.92.1][V3-05] Implement Repository Context And Read-Only V2 Import

values.goal: Resolve repository and issue context deterministically and import v2 records without granting v3 mutation authority.
values.required_outcome: deterministic discovery unsupported-field reporting and no-write proof is produced at an exact revision and independently reproducible.
declared_scope: Root discovery, canonical repository identity, remote resolution, branch/worktree observation, issue selection precedence, symlink-safe paths, v2 record/card parsing, unsupported-field reporting, and normalized read-only projections.
authority_boundary: Issue V3-05 owns only its declared repository paths and named external operation/evidence boundary.
Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked changes on main
Bind only after typed doctor reports ready
Do not cross dependency or stop gates
Keep evidence producer-derived and exact-revision bound
